Title: Finmath Binding Library
Summary: C/C++ library for fast financial math operations. Bound to Python with a pip package and expanded functionality. By using techniques like SIMD, the project has seen up to 300x faster operations than NumPy on linear regression models, including 34x faster operations on large datasets (> 500k datapoints).
Contributors: Lalit Boyapati, Philip Wisniewski, Ray Han, William Zhang

Title: FPGA Pricing
Summary: Implementing a parallel Monte Carlo risk simulation engine (pseudo-random number generation, fixed-point path updates, parallel simulation lanes, and hardware accumulation logic) using FPGAs. Previously saw 50x improvement on latency per option over microcontroller units when implementing the Black Scholes pricing model.
Contributors: Aiden Drepaniotis, Pragathi Arunkumar, Chenxi Zhang, Justin Chen, Gavin Payne

Title: Order Book Modeling
Summary: Simulating an event driven Limit Order Book to study market making dynamics. The project models stochastic order flow and queue dynamics to provide a controlled environment for testing inventory-aware market making strategies under varying liquidity and volatility regimes.
Contributors: Rohit Manjunath, Neel Chawla, Ryan Challman

Title: GTO Poker Solver
Summary: Developing a high-performance Game Theory Optimal (GTO) solver for poker variants using Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR). Building an engine to simulate millions of iterations of gameplay to minimize "regret," converging on an unexploitable Nash Equilibrium strategy. Optimizing the computational efficiency of the solver and visualizing how the bot learns to balance its range and bluff frequencies in an environment of imperfect information.
Contributors: Sayam Goyal, Sandilya Kambhampati, Pritam Hazra, Kashyap Maddala

Title: GPU Acceleration
Summary: Speeding up machine learning trading models with custom GPU kernels in CUDA C++ for high frequency trading models. Running the models on Purdue's GPU cluster and benchmarking them with the standard PyTorch implementations to measure performance gain.
Contributors: Pranith Ravella, Nathan Witt, Hargun Singh, Alexander Chen

Title: Prediction Markets Microstructure
Summary: Studying liquidity dynamics and behavioral biases in prediction markets through order book microstructure analysis. Testing whether order flow exhibits inertia during sports events, where emotional betting creates liquidity regime shifts. The team will develop and backtest different liquidity models to identify exploitable inefficiencies in under-researched markets.
Contributors: Ethan Lee, David Oprea, Mitchell Patout, Ruhaan Bhargav, Kevin Karram

Title: Live Trading Simulator
Summary: Building a competitive platform where users predict market movements using information from anonymized charts and historical news. The backend will handle real-time state synchronization for concurrent users.
Contributors: Uday Manneru, Shivani Sinha, Arya Bharath

Title: Agentic Quant Researcher
Summary: Replicating the quant researcher and technical analysis roles with RAG agents. These will research companies in different sectors to provide critical information in developing trading strategies. Agents will have an edge based solely on the large data quantities they can ingest.
Contributors: Dhruv Jhamb, Hamza Adwan, Aarush Agarwal, Taymur Faruqui

Title: Finmath Library
Summary: This team developed finmath, a financial math calculation library that offers the functionality of a traditional Python library while leveraging C/C++ for enhanced speed and efficiency.
Contributors: Shashank Mukkera, Prajwal Shah, Anish Kambhampati, Segyul Park, Om Janamanchi, Kobe Huang, Ben Wu, Aviral Rastogi, Sarthak Tandon

Title: Options Pricing
Summary: This team developed an ARIMA and LSTM model to predict implied volatility, using Streamlit and interpolation techniques to visualize the implied volatility surface.
Contributors: Mihika Ghaisas, Ritwik Jain, Lucas Embrey, Parth Hathalia, Rich Smith

Title: Sports Arbitrage
Summary: Starting broadly, this team identified NBA player props as a key area for arbitrage potential. They then built a website, integrating sportsbook APIs, to find and document arbitrage opportunities their algorithm identified.
Contributors: Jamie Borst, Sebastian Bohrt, Aditya Naidu, Kestan Kamei, Ephram Chun

Title: FPGA Mini Projects
Summary: This team gained hands on experience with FPGAs, advanced hardware often used in quant finance for ultra-low-latency performance. Projects included building a calculator, conducting an echo test, and developing a VGA proof-of-concept.
Contributors: Rohin Nair, Justin Shakergayen, Thanh Bui Minh

Title: Stochastic Markov Models
Summary: This team leveraged Python and Jupyter Notebook to identify hidden Markov models and analyze stochastic processes, focusing on their applications in commodities markets and cyclical market conditions.
Contributors: Avi Kumar, Peter Henwood, Pritam Hazra

Title: Adaptive Algorithms
Summary: This team applied online learning methods in energy markets, focusing on ERCOT to dynamically update model parameters and maximize value in an ever-shifting environment.
Contributors: Arnav Arora, Ryan Wans, Srikar Lanka, Matthew Wind, Alexander Brady, Akash Gaonkar, Mario Arenas

Title: Sports Arbitrage
Summary: Identifying hedging opportunities within NBA player props, optimizing strategies, and launching a website for tracking positive EV bets.
Contributors: Jamie Borst, Sebastian Bohrt, Adi Naidu, Leo Navarro, Parth Hathalia

Title: Finmath Library
Summary: Developing a C/C++ financial math library, bound to Python, with a working pip package and expanded functionality.
Contributors: Shashank Mukkera, Prajwal Shah, Benjamin Wu, Aviral Rastogi, Rahul Siddharth, Hayagreev Dilip, Sarthak Tandon

Title: FPGA-based Pricing Model
Summary: Building an FPGA-based options pricing engine, processing real-time data for low-latency Black-Scholes calculations.
Contributors: Rohin Nair, Avi Kumar, Caleb Suhy, Nishaant Shah, Parth Gupta

Title: Ports Startup
Summary: Enhancing fintech portfolio platform Ports, members act as developers to add social features and improve user experience through mini projects.
Contributors: Pradyum Chitlu, Richard Smith, Matthew Wind, Sandi Kambhampati

Title: ML Sentiment Analysis
Summary: Using NLP to analyze news, social media, and Google Trends, generating ML-based trading signals and market sentiment insights.
Contributors: Mario Arenas, Akash Gaonkar, Zayn Rekhi, Nathan Li, Pritam Hazra

Title: Crypto Arbitrage
Summary: Detecting triangular arbitrage on Binance, simulating trades and optimizing execution timing.
Contributors: Arnav Kalekar, Peter Henwood, Om Janamanchi, Yohaan Chokhany, Aarav Mohanty, Aiden Drepaniotis

Title: Predictive Player Props
Summary: Using ML models to forecast NFL player stats, such as wide receiver yards, and comparing predictions against betting lines
Contributors: Tomas Valenzuela, Uday Manneru, Sanjith Prabhu, Sreekar Gudipati, Nihal Gunukula

Title: GPU Acceleration
Summary: Reimplementing ML models with custom GPU kernels to benchmark training and inference speedups.
Contributors: Nishaant Shah, Rahul Siddharth, Aiden Huang, Aadi Jain, Om Janamanchi

Title: Finmath Binding Library
Summary: Developing a C/C++ financial math library, bound to Python, with a working pip package and expanded functionality.
Contributors: Prajwal Shah, Shashank Mukkera, Daniyal Bekinalkar, Chenxi Zhang, Lalit Boyapati, Aviral Rastogi

Title: Sportsbook Scraper
Summary: Fast web scraper to pull sportsbook odds for arbitrage and +EV sports trading.
Contributors: Sebastian Bohrt, Mike Carranza, Ethan Lee

Title: Alt Data Momentum Trading
Summary: Python backtester combining alternative data (Google Trends, app store ranks, weather) with technical indicators to predict stock moves.
Contributors: Aarav Mohanty, Pradyum Chitlu, Matthew Wind, Peter Henwood

Title: Tradify
Summary: AI powered agent that takes a stock ticker and outputs options trades with quantitative backing.
Contributors: Parth Gupta, Sandi Kambhampati, Ayush Agarwal, Uday Manneru, Mihika Shrivastava

Title: Market Mechanics
Summary: Researching and implementing methods to simulate market-making order books. In parallel, replicating key papers on pairs trading and designing custom RL based approaches.
Contributors: Nathan Li, Segyul Park, Arnav Kalekar, Sairah Ghule, Maraio Arenas, Shivani Sinha, Rohit Manjunath

Title: Social Stock Exchange
Summary: Partnering with a startup, building an exchange where fans can invest in creators, teams, and cultural icons like stocks.
Contributors: Parth Hathalia, David Oprea, Ropan Datta, Maria Clara Valle Gomes, Pranith Ravella, Rohan Gupta

Title: Prediction Markets Alpha Mining
Summary: Through prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket, explore arbitrage and relative value market making opportunities.
Contributors: Leo Navarro, Sayam Goyal, Trinidad Segovia, Yohaan Chokhany, Dhruv Jhamb

Title: FPGA
Summary: Trying to replicate strategies used by high frequency trading firms with FPGAs gifted by Belvedere.
Contributors: Caleb Suhy, Riya Chamala, Navneeth Krishna, Pragathi Arunkumar, Aiden Drepaniotis
